_comment: Phase 2.4 retrieval benchmark. Fixed corpus + query set with known-relevant docs. Corpus is modelled on real YAPOC memory shapes (sampled from the live DB) and deliberately includes the high-volume low-signal noise that dominates memory in practice, because resisting it is what retrieval must do. Do not regenerate casually: changing the corpus invalidates comparison across runs.

documents.content: task: investigate repeated planning failures | result: planning exhausted its 45-turn limit on four consecutive implementation tasks; raising the cap from 15 to 30 to 45 did not help, the work is discarded each time
Decision: turn exhaustion now records status=partial and re-enqueues a continuation carrying the agent's own progress, bounded by max_task_continuations (default 3)

health_check: Gemini requests failed with 400 INVALID_ARGUMENT 'You can only set only one of thinking budget and thinking level'; fixed by writing the protobuf field directly instead of the typed ThinkingConfig wrapper
task: builder could not start | result: all 4 adapters in the fallback chain failed to start streaming tools, last error was an HTTPStatusError from Google Gemini
Discovery: task_queue.cost_usd was 0.0 for all 1175 rows because the dispatcher had a literal pass where cost accumulation belonged
Discovery: the observability dashboard reported zero errors for 24 hours while 41 tasks had actually failed, because the counters read HEALTH.MD only and ignored the tasks table
Note: memory_entries.provenance was written by only one of eleven indexer call sites, leaving 2473 of 2480 rows without any record of which file they came from
Config change: librarian task_timeout reduced from 900 to 300 seconds after measuring that its slowest successful task ever was 161 seconds
Security finding: the write lock on app/agents/security was bypassed by path traversal because the rule matched a path substring rather than a normalized path
Security finding: the destructive shell rule matched only the literal spelling rm -rf, so rm -fr and rm --recursive --force walked past the gate
Note: the frontend uses pnpm with pnpm-lock.yaml; there is no package-lock.json, so any CI job running npm ci will fail
Project rule: dependencies are managed with poetry only. Never run pip install directly; use poetry add and poetry install
Project rule: all configuration lives in app/config/settings.py using pydantic-settings. Never read environment variables with os.environ in application code
Architecture: agents communicate through a Redis message bus and a SQLite task queue; each agent is file-isolated under app/agents/<name>
Discovery: 22 backend tests failed with 401 because Starlette TestClient identifies as host testserver, which the access middleware correctly refuses as non-loopback
Note: truncate_text in app/utils/helpers.py is an intentional no-op pass-through and has no callers; its tests asserted removed behaviour
Feature: send_telegram_media tool added so agents can deliver photos and documents through the Telegram surface
Feature: render_chart_image renders a chart to an image file rather than returning a spec, so charts can be delivered over Telegram
Feature: the file viewer pane gained a Raw/Preview toggle that renders markdown through react-markdown with GFM support
Integration: chrome-devtools-mcp requires an explicit executablePath because it looks for Google Chrome at /opt/google/chrome/chrome and will not fall back to Chromium
Note: chrome-devtools-mcp page-scoped tools require an integer pageId; passing the string "2" fails with Expected number, received string
task: evaluator self-evaluation failed | result: Incomplete provider response: length, the report write exceeded max_tokens before completing
Config: per-task, per-agent and daily budget caps are enforced during streaming; exceeding one aborts the task with BUDGET EXCEEDED
Recovery: git autocheckpoint commits before risky work and rolls back when the smoke check fails after it
The concilium engine runs a multi-agent deliberation and returns a single approved decision; it was rewritten and is exposed as the deliberate tool
User preference: browser voiceover sounded bad, so TTS and STT were switched to OpenAI models
User preference: keep the dark theme dark, with FFB633 as the main accent colour
The doctor agent reads every agent's HEALTH.MD, detects anomalies and reports them; it does not fix code itself
The librarian consolidates and archives agent memory, summarising old entries so the live log stays short
Memory decay archives entries older than the threshold into data/memory_archive and marks them tier=cold so normal retrieval skips them
